sources.snippet: RegNet-X 160 is a convolutional neural network architecture from Meta AI's (Facebook) RegNet family, designed as an efficient and scalable backbone for image classification and feature extraction. It targets researchers and engineers who need a lightweight yet high-performing CNN for computer vision tasks such as classification, detection, and segmentation.
